intro: Simulator bay cost (Nov 9 research): Tennis-specific simulators (V1 Tennis Simulator / Tennis Social AI) are pre-sale, no public pricing yet -- get a direct quote from them. Best proxy is golf simulator bays (same hardware stack: launch monitor, impact screen, projector, enclosure, room build-out) -- commercial-grade bays run roughly $25,000-$75,000 all-in, premium (Trackman-class) can hit $100k+. Working budget estimate: ~$30,000-$50,000 per bay for a solid commercial setup until a real tennis-specific quote comes in. Confirms the assumption: well under the cost of building one real tennis court.
